description: ICP & IDNO Briefings is a dataset listed in Northern Powergrid open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Northern Powergrid. Our ICP Briefing Library contains information which has been circulated to our ICP & IDNO email mailing list. This could include but not limited to, technical or process changes and updates. The information is updated as and when issued to the mailing list and provides visibility to our stakeholders of shared information. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal files it under Network. Its keywords are ICP/IDNO. The portal shows 2026-01-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Northern Powergrid Open Data Licence v1.0 (https://northernpowergrid.opendatasoft.com/p/opendatalicence/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-npg-open-data-portal.
